notes: Nettle Burst, back half: behind the player; anchor = the player's feet; the hits land on frame 3
Nettle Burst, front half: in front of the player (the falling leaves too); same anchor and timing as the back half
Herbal Storm, back half: behind mobs; anchor = the target's feet (centre of the area); loop for 1 s
Herbal Storm, front half: in front of mobs; same anchor and timing as the back half
Fever Wave: the wave, drawn pushing right; rotate it to the facing (flip for the west side) and move it from the palms along the line; anchor = its centre
Wildroot, back half: the roots behind mobs; anchor = the target's feet (centre of the area); the roots stand tallest on frames 3-8
Wildroot, front half: the roots in front of mobs; same anchor and timing as the back half
Spirit Lash: the vine whip, drawn reaching right from the palm; rotate it towards the target (flip for the west side); anchor = the palm; play it once per lash, the hit on frame 7
Spirit Smoke: the smoke curling round the mob; anchor = the mob's feet; follow the mob and loop while the ticks last
